mechanics.claim: Void Assault grants invisibility and can be cast a second time after breaking invisibility, at no additional cost.
mechanics.quote: Upon breaking invisibility, ''Void Assault'' can be cast a second time at no additional cost.

mechanics.claim: Evolved Void Assault allows up to 3 total casts (initial cast plus two recasts) instead of 2.
mechanics.quote: The {{tip|invisibility}} now lasts 2 seconds, and ''Void Assault'' can be recast twice.

mechanics.claim: A recast mimics the effects of the first cast (re-stealths and grants the movement speed buff again).
Using a basic attack breaks stealth at the end of the attack windup, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Using a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|breaks stealth}} at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Each cast of Void Assault counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade).
mechanics.quote: Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast, not on the recast window ending.
